primary_endpoint: Number of participants with AEs and SAEs, from treatment start to 28 days after treatment (up to 113 days).
safety_signal: No SAEs or deaths: 0/20 with LYS006 and 0/21 with LYS006 + LJN452. AE participant counts listed were 14 and 17, respectively, in one set of entries; other listed counts were not labeled by event category.
